summary: The accepted GAME-TEMPLATE-01 capability map joins F01–F12 and the seven unified-roadmap coverage rows to public producer sources, template examples, receiver assertions and remaining dependencies. FourDReference composes local session/input/hit testing but admits the legal full-cell command without changing domain state; internal snapshot/restore callbacks do not supply a versioned save/replay control journey. ExternalAuthorityReference retains unknown receipts independently of presentation/reconnect and requires explicit reconciliation or abandonment followed by rearm; its mock grants no native authority. Complete-only opt-in WASM source-browser and coherent publication evidence remain separate from downloaded-only installed/retaining acceptance, with Firefox compatibility and wrapper-versus-native Worker cleanup limits retained. Managed Portal adoption/removal is scoped independently of browser physics and whole P3. Later focus/idempotent DOM source corrections are not automatically present in the selected published Rendering package. Consult the canonical owning plan for current qualification; the map introduces no producer defect, default, API, release or whole-feature completion. Products retain their own gameplay, saves, native gateways and acceptance.
title: Game template capability mapping preserves consumer acceptance boundaries
